Envelope.description:
Envelope reaches every pair from a use site. Field names are the lower-camel
cell ID, so a golden diff names its own cell.

fieldArrayAlias.description: FieldArrayAlias is the array pair, alias half.

fieldArrayNamed.description: FieldArrayNamed is the array pair, named half.

fieldBasicAlias.description: FieldBasicAlias is the basic pair, alias half, in plain field position.

fieldBasicNamed.description: FieldBasicNamed is the basic pair, named half, in plain field position.

fieldChainAlias.description: FieldChainAlias is the chain pair, alias half.

fieldSliceAlias.description: FieldSliceAlias is the slice pair, alias half.

fieldSliceNamed.description: FieldSliceNamed is the slice pair, named half.

fieldStructNamed.description: FieldStructNamed is the struct pair, named half.

mapValueBasicAlias.description: MapValueBasicAlias reaches the basic pair's alias half as a map value.

mapValueBasicNamed.description: MapValueBasicNamed reaches the basic pair's named half as a map value.

mapValueStructAlias.description: MapValueStructAlias reaches the struct pair's alias half as a map value.

mapValueStructNamed.description: MapValueStructNamed reaches the struct pair's named half as a map value.

pointerBasicAlias.description: PointerBasicAlias reaches the basic pair's alias half through a pointer.

pointerBasicNamed.description: PointerBasicNamed reaches the basic pair's named half through a pointer.

pointerStructNamed.description: PointerStructNamed reaches the struct pair's named half through a pointer.

sliceElemBasicAlias.description: SliceElemBasicAlias reaches the basic pair's alias half as a slice element.

sliceElemBasicNamed.description: SliceElemBasicNamed reaches the basic pair's named half as a slice element.

sliceElemStructAlias.description: SliceElemStructAlias reaches the struct pair's alias half as a slice element.

sliceElemStructNamed.description: SliceElemStructNamed reaches the struct pair's named half as a slice element.

EnvelopeModeled.title: EnvelopeModeled reaches the model-annotated pairs from a use site.

modeledBasicAlias.description: ModeledBasicAlias is the annotated basic pair, alias half.

ModeledBasicAlias.description:
ModeledBasicAlias is the basic pair's alias half WITH a model annotation — the
annotation that stops buildAlias dissolving at the use site (schema.go:426).

ModeledBasicNamed.title: ModeledBasicNamed is the basic pair's named half WITH a model annotation.

ModeledStructAlias.title: ModeledStructAlias is the struct pair's alias half WITH a model annotation.

ModeledStructNamed.title: ModeledStructNamed is the struct pair's named half WITH a model annotation.

PlainTarget.description:
It carries no format annotation of its own, so any format on the pair's members
can only come from the pair's own declaration.
PlainTarget.title: PlainTarget is an unannotated struct used as the RHS of the struct-kind pair.

left.description:
Left is a plain field, present so the struct has observable content when
the format is NOT applied.

StrfmtChainNamed.description:
It carries no annotation itself: the format must be inherited from
BaseFormatted, one declaration to the right (inheritedStrfmt).
StrfmtChainNamed.title: StrfmtChainNamed is a named type declared over an ALREADY-annotated named type.
